items.title: 18.8.2 Sex Linked Disorders in Humans (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of sex-linked disorders in humans (PDF 106, 108-110).

blocks.text: Haemophilia aik kam milne wali X-linked recessive bimari hai jis mein chot ke baad khoon theek se nahi jamta, kyunke khoon jamane wale factors kam, kharab ya ghair maujood hote hain. Is ki teen qismein hain.

blocks.caption: Haemophilia ki qismein
rows: Autosomal recessive; dono jinson mein barabar

items: Chot lagne par platelets us jagah chipak kar platelet plug banate hain.
Fa'al platelets aur zakhmi tissue clotting factors chhorte hain.
Clotting factors reactions ka silsila (clotting cascade) chalate hain jis mein ghulne wala protein fibrinogen na ghulne wale fibrin mein badalta hai.
Fibrin jaal banata hai jo khoon ke hisse phansa kar thos lothra (clot) banata hai.
Fibrin ke dhagon ke aapas mein jurne (cross-linking) se clot mazboot hota hai.

blocks.text: Agar clotting nizam ka tawazun bigar jaye to ghair maamooli jamao, thrombosis, ho sakta hai jo stroke aur dil ke daure jaise sangeen masail paida karta hai.

blocks.prompt: Do normal walidain ka bachcha haemophiliac hai. Walidain ke genotypes kya ho sakte hain?
blocks.explanation: Maa XH Xh (carrier) aur baap XH Y; mutasir bachcha beta hai, Xh Y. Normal baap ki mutasir beti nahi ho sakti.

blocks.text: Normal (trichromatic) nazar walon ki retina mein teen qisam ke cone cells hote hain, har aik aik bunyadi rang ke liye hassas: surkh, hare aur neele ke liye hassas cones, har aik ke apne pigment proteins jinhein opsins kehte hain. Surkh aur hare opsins ke genes X chromosome par aur neele opsin ka gene autosome 7 par hai; in opsin genes ke recessive alleles rang-andha pan paida karte hain.

blocks.alt: Oopar: normal trichromatic nazar, surkh, hare aur neele cones; dabbe batate hain ke surkh aur hare opsin ke genes X chromosome par aur neele opsin ka gene chromosome 7 par hai. Darmiyan: dichromacy, cones ke teen set, har aik mein aik ghayab: protanopia (surkh nahi), deuteranopia (hara nahi) aur tritanopia (neela nahi). Neeche: monochromacy, do opsins ghayab; blue-cone monochromacy mein surkh aur hare opsins nahi.
blocks.caption: Cone opsins, dichromacy aur monochromacy (Figure 18.18 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Normal (trichromatic) nazar retina ke teen qisam ke cone cells use karti hai jo surkh, hari aur neeli roshni ke liye hassas hain, har aik ka apna opsin pigment protein. Surkh aur hare opsin ke genes X chromosome par aur neele opsin ka gene chromosome 7 par hai; in genes ke recessive alleles rang-andha pan (colour-blindness) paida karte hain. Dichromacy mein aik opsin nahi hota, to insan do bunyadi rang dekhta aur teesre ke liye andha hota hai: protanopia (surkh), deuteranopia (hara) ya tritanopia (neela). Monochromacy mein do opsins nahi hote; blue-cone monochromacy mein surkh aur hare opsins nahi hote, jab ke red-cone aur green-cone monochromacy bohat kam hain.

items: Dichromacy: do bunyadi rang dikhna aur teesre ke liye andha pan jis ka opsin nahi: surkh-andha pan (protanopia), hara-andha pan (deuteranopia) ya neela-andha pan (tritanopia).

Monochromacy (mukammal rang-andha pan): sirf aik rang dikhna aur un do ke liye andha pan jin ke opsins nahi. Blue-cone monochromacy mein surkh aur hare opsins nahi hote; red-cone aur green-cone monochromacy bohat kam hain.

blocks.title: 'Red-green colour-blindness' kaun si haalat hai?
blocks.text: Kitab blue-cone monochromacy ko 'red-green colour-blindness' kehti hai. Red-green colour-blindness ka naam aam taur par un aam X-linked soorton ke liye hai jin mein sirf surkh ya hara opsin ghayab ya kharab ho (protanopia, deuteranopia aur un ki halki soorten); blue-cone monochromacy aik alag, kam milne wali haalat hai.

Rang-andhe pan ka ilaaj nahi, lekin madadgar technology jaise colour-blind ainak aur khaas software rang pehchanne mein madad dete hain, aur kuch log rang pehchanne ki tarbiyat se bhi kamyab hue hain.

30 se zyada bimariyan muscular dystrophies kehlati hain, aur Duchenne muscular dystrophy sab se aam hai. Yeh X-linked recessive hai, is liye mardon mein zyada hai; taqreeban do tihai cases maa se virasat mein aur aik tihai nayi mutation se hote hain. Recessive allele pane wala mard muscle protein dystrophin nahi bana sakta, is liye muscle fibres mar jate aur skeletal muscles kamzor ho kar toot te hain, pehle koolhon, pelvis, raanon aur pindliyon ke, phir kandhon aur gardan, baazuon, saans aur dil ke muscles aur doosre hisson ke.

blocks.alt: Teen jismani khaake, mutasir muscles jamni rang mein: pehle koolhe, pelvis, raanein aur pindliyan; baad mein kandhe aur baazu bhi; aakhir mein seena bhi, saans aur dil ke muscles. Timeline: taqreeban 4 saal ki umr mein chalte hue kamzori, 10 tak braces, 12 tak wheelchair, aur aam umr 15 se 45. Dabbe mein wajah aur ilaaj.
blocks.caption: Duchenne muscular dystrophy ka silsila (Figure 18.19 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Duchenne muscular dystrophy, 30 se zyada muscular dystrophies mein sab se aam, X-linked recessive hai, is liye larkon mein kaheen zyada hoti hai; taqreeban do tihai cases maa se virasat mein aate aur aik tihai nayi mutation se. Mutasir larka muscle protein dystrophin nahi bana sakta, is liye muscle fibres mar jate hain. Kamzori taqreeban chaar saal ki umr mein, jab chalna shuru hota hai, koolhon, pelvis, raanon aur pindliyon se shuru ho kar kandhon, gardan, baazuon aur saans aur dil ke muscles tak phailti hai. 10 saal tak braces aur 12 tak aksar wheelchair; aam umr 15 se 45 saal. Ilaaj (cure) nahi; physiotherapy, corticosteroids, dard ki dawa aur jorron ke khinchao (contractures) ki surgery madad karti hain.

blocks.text: Yeh taqreeban chaar saal ki umr mein bachche ko mutasir karti aur chalna shuru karne par zahir hoti hai. 10 saal tak bachche ko braces chahiye ho sakte hain, aur 12 tak zyada tar mareez chal nahi sakte aur wheelchair chahiye hoti hai. Aam umr 15 se 45 saal. Ilaaj (cure) nahi, lekin alamaat qaboo ki jati hain: physical therapy taqat, lachak aur harkat qaim rakhti; corticosteroids thori muddat ke liye muscles ki taqat behtar karte; dard ki dawaen muscles ka dard kam karti; aur surgery jorron ke khinchao (contractures) theek karti hai.

Embryonic screening un tareeqon ko kehte hain jo janeen mein genetic bimariyan aur chromosomes ki ghair maamooli tadaad jaanchte hain, jaise ultrasound scan, chorionic villus sampling aur amniocentesis.

blocks.alt: Hamla bachcha-daani (uterus) ka saada khaaka: gulabi deewar, mure hue janeen ke gird mayi ki neeli amniotic theli, aur neeche baen placenta. Lambi sui oopar se amniotic theli mein jati hai, aur pait par rakha ultrasound probe janeen ki taraf lehrein bhejta hai. Saath numbered qadam: janeen ke cells wala mayi nikala jata, cells culture mein ugaye jate, aur un ke chromosomes check hote hain.
blocks.caption: Amniocentesis (kitab ke embryonic screening box ke liye asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Embryonic screening janeen (embryo ya foetus) mein genetic bimariyon aur chromosomes ki ghair maamooli tadaad ki jaanch hai; tareeqon mein ultrasound scan, chorionic villus sampling aur amniocentesis shamil hain. Amniocentesis aam taur par hamal ke 15ven aur 20ven hafte ke darmiyan hoti hai. Ultrasound probe janeen ki jagah dhoondta hai jab ke lambi sui amniotic theli mein dal kar thora amniotic mayi nikala jata hai, jis mein janeen ke jhare hue cells hote hain. Yeh cells culture medium mein ugaye jate aur un ke chromosomes ki tadaad ghair maamooli hone ke liye dekhi jati hai.

blocks.text: Amniocentesis aam taur par hamal ke 15ven aur 20ven hafte ke darmiyan ki jati hai. Lambi sui amniotic theli mein dali jati hai jab ke ultrasound probe janeen ki jagah dhoondta hai; sui janeen ke cells wala thora amniotic mayi nikalti hai, jinhein culture medium mein rakh kar chromosomes ki ghair maamooli tadaad ke liye jaancha jata hai.

items: Haemophilia A (factor VIII) aur B (IX) X-linked recessive; C (XI) autosomal.
Surkh aur hare opsin genes X par, neela chromosome 7 par; dichromacy aur monochromacy.
Duchenne: dystrophin nahi; taqreeban 4 par alamaat, taqreeban 12 tak wheelchair.
15-20 hafte par amniocentesis janeen ke chromosomes jaanchti hai.
